title: Summer coast in 7 days
summary: Da Nang, Hoi An, Lang Co, and Quy Nhon. May to August. Some road minutes are Check on arrival.

days.title: Day 1 — Da Nang
days.body: My Khe is half a day and free to swim.

days.title: Day 3 — An Bang
days.body: An Bang is half a day. The fee is Check on arrival.

days.title: Day 4 — Lang Co
days.body: Lang Co Beach is a swim and a walk. Use the Hue to Lang Co page.

days.title: Day 5 — Toward Quy Nhon
days.body: Travel toward Quy Nhon. The minutes are Check on arrival.

days.title: Day 6 — Ky Co
days.body: Ky Co is about an hour. The posted range is 30,000–60,000 đồng.

days.title: Day 7 — Leave
days.body: Keep the morning on the city beach, which is free.
